meta.name: cost-optimization
meta.description: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的云服务账单持续走高又难以定位浪费。
copy.tagline_en: Cut cloud costs and optimize resource usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your cloud bill keeps climbing and you can't find where the waste is.

howto.what: 给出 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 的云成本优化方案:调整资源规格、打成本标签、用预留实例与 Spot、设预算告警和存储生命周期策略,并输出 Terraform 配置片段与落地检查清单。
howto.when: 当你想降低云费用、分析基础设施成本或落地成本治理策略时触发;适用于 AWS、Azure、GCP 等多云环境。
